itemized.notes: Warren T. Rogers, County Council At Large B (Constitution party), FINAL / DISSOLUTION report, signed 5-2-12, clerk-stamped MAY 04 2012. A hand-written annotation across the top of the cover reads 'Applies to 2010 County Council At Large B race' - the filer's own statement of which race this closes out, which matches index.csv's election_year 2012 only loosely; recorded here, not corrected. PAGE ORDER IS SHUFFLED: PDF page 2 is Schedule A (form footer 3), PDF page 3 is Schedule B (form footer 4), PDF page 4 is the Summary Page (form footer 2). Both schedules are explicitly NIL - the filer wrote the word 'None' into the first row of each grid and entered a written 0 in each SUBTOTAL. Summary Page lines 1-7 Column A are all written zeros; Column B carries 295.98 on both lines 1 and 2 (identical aggregate on both sides). PRIVACY: the cover's street-address block and the phone/fax/email block are county-redacted. Both sides are a real zero, not a gap.
